rows.label: Pounds of donated food Feeding America passed to member food banks, FY2025

source.title: Feeding America, financial report June 30, 2025 (audited)
source.quote: During fiscal years 2025 and 2024, Feeding America donated 2,409 million pounds and 2,347 million pounds, respectively, of food product to its network members.

rows.explainer: The food under Feeding America's national donor contracts (1,995 million pounds) and given to it directly (414 million). Food the members source themselves, buy, or get from USDA is not in it.

rows.label: Fair value of a pound of donated food, FY2025 (wholesale, US$)

source.title: Feeding America, financial report June 30, 2025 (audited)
source.quote: expense at the estimated average fair value of one pound of donated food product at the national level of $1.90 and $1.97 for fiscal years 2025 and 2024, respectively.

rows.explainer: Feeding America's yearly study of 31 product categories at national wholesalers' catalogue prices: wholesale, below what a household pays at a store.
